title: Claude Kit — Handoff & Verdict Payload Schema
description: Validates .claude/workflow-state/*-handoff.json inter-phase payloads AND structured review verdicts emitted by plan-reviewer / code-reviewer agents. oneOf switches on either $handoff_contract (handoff envelope) or $verdict_contract (verdict envelope). Schema version 1.1.0 (additive minor): added coder_to_code_review contract (D2 from post-1.17-symmetry-audit). Existing 1.0.0 fixtures remain valid (additive only).

artifact.description: Path to the plan file, e.g. .claude/prompts/{feature}.md

spec_artifact.description: Path to spec file if spec_referenced=true, null otherwise.

key_decisions.description: Architectural decisions with rationale, one string per decision.

known_risks.description: Known risks, one string per risk.

areas_needing_attention.description: Parts/areas for reviewer to focus on, one string per area.

approved_with_notes.description: Notes for coder: areas requiring attention, one string per note.

iteration.description: Review iteration counter, format N/3 where N in {1,2,3}.

plan_review_verdict.title: plan_review_verdict
plan_review_verdict.description: Structured verdict payload emitted by plan-reviewer inside a VERDICT_JSON: fenced block. Envelope contains the verdict itself plus an embedded plan_review_to_coder handoff.

verdict.description: plan-reviewer verdict. APPROVED_WITH_COMMENTS / CHANGES_REQUESTED are code-reviewer-only values and MUST NOT appear here — use the discriminator to pick the right envelope.

issues.description: Review issues. Empty array is valid — zero issues is a legitimate APPROVED state.

id.description: Canonical issue identifier: PR-<first-8-hex-chars-of-sha256(category|location|problem)>. Computed by save-review-checkpoint.sh (IMP-03) before schema validation. Agents emit free-form advisory ids; hook overwrites them with the canonical form.

category.description: Classification: architecture | security | error_handling | completeness | style | other.

handoff.description: Embedded inter-phase handoff. Shape MUST match plan_review_to_coder — fully validated.

parts_validated.description: IMP-04: optional list of Part IDs that received full architecture validation on iter 2+. UNCHANGED Parts are NOT in this list. Absent on iter 1 (backward compat — section-absence signal).

code_review_verdict.title: code_review_verdict
code_review_verdict.description: Structured verdict payload emitted by code-reviewer inside a VERDICT_JSON: fenced block. Envelope contains the verdict plus a MINIMUM-VIABLE embedded handoff; full code_review_to_completion contract is scoped to IMP-01.2.

verdict.description: code-reviewer verdict. All five legacy variants preserved — legacy NEEDS_CHANGES / REJECTED and modern APPROVED_WITH_COMMENTS / CHANGES_REQUESTED both legal for cross-version compatibility.

issues.description: Review issues. Empty array is valid — zero issues is a legitimate APPROVED state.

id.description: Canonical issue identifier: CR-<first-8-hex-chars-of-sha256(category|location|problem)>. Computed by save-review-checkpoint.sh (IMP-03) before schema validation.

handoff.description: MINIMUM-VIABLE embedded handoff (IMP-02 scope). Full code_review_to_completion shape is IMP-01.2. additionalProperties: true deliberately — accepts future fields without breaking.

coder_to_code_review.title: coder_to_code_review
coder_to_code_review.description: Handoff from /coder to code-reviewer agent (D2 from post-1.17-symmetry-audit). Mirrors planner_to_plan_review validation depth on the C-stage side. Closes asymmetry where C-stage handoff was previously unvalidated by schema (annotation 'IMP-01.2 future' resolved at schema 1.1.0).

branch.description: Git branch where /coder committed implementation (code-reviewer reviews in worktree from this branch).

parts_implemented.description: Parts implemented per plan, one string per Part with brief description.

evaluate_adjustments.description: Inline adjustments documented during /coder Phase 1.5 EVALUATE (REVISE decisions).

risks_mitigated.description: Risks identified during EVALUATE/IMPLEMENT and how they were resolved.

deviations_from_plan.description: Deviations from approved plan with rationale; empty array = no deviations.

verify_status.description: Output of /coder Phase 3 VERIFY. lint and test enums map to canonical PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED states; SKIPPED is legitimate when no VERIFY_CMD resolves (per coder.md verify_startup cascade SKIP-with-NIT branch).

command_used.description: VERIFY command resolved at coder Phase 3 startup (PK > CLAUDE.md > SKIP cascade).

spec_check.description: Output of /coder Phase 3.5 SPEC CHECK. Optional — present for L/XL complexity; missing for S complexity (lightweight mode).

iteration.description: Code-review iteration counter, format N/3 where N in {1,2,3} (max 3 per workflow loop limit).
